turns.question: For leads that turned into a booking in September 2026, what was the median number of days from lead creation to booking?
turns.answer: The semantic layer has no metric for a median number of days from lead creation to booking, so I cannot give that figure. The closest metrics are Lead-to-booking rate (the share of leads that booked within 30 days of being created, counted on the lead's creation day) and Bookings (bookings made by leads, on the day they were made).
